# get flux data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
          "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
          "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

read_hh <- function(zip_file) {
  # find the half-hourly FLUXMET file inside this zip
  hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)[1]
  # unzip only that csv
  unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = "data/raw/unzipped", overwrite = T)
  # read it
  hh <- read_csv(file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
               na = "-9999",
               col_select = any_of(keep),
               col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d"))
  hh$site <- str_extract(basename(hh_name), "[A-Z]{2}-[A-Za-z0-9]+") # add site id from file name
  return(hh)} # return clean table

zip_files <- list.files(here("data", "raw"), pattern = "\\.zip$", full.names = TRUE)

flux <- map_dfr(zip_files, read_hh) # apply the functiont to each one and combine results
flux <- flux |> mutate(time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"))
flux[flux == -9999] <- NA
```

# preparation of flux data
```{r}
flux_static <- flux |>
  mutate(across(c(TA_F, P_F), ~ na_if(.x, -9999))) |>
  mutate(year = year(time)) |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(
    annual_mean_temp = mean(TA_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_total_precip = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  summarise(
    flux_mean_temp = mean(annual_mean_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    flux_total_precip = mean(annual_total_precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(site_id = site)

print(flux_static)
```

# get datasets
```{r}
worldclim <- read_csv(here("data/external/worldclim/worldclim_bio_my_sites.csv"))
soilgrids <- read_csv(here("data/external/soilgrids/soilgrids_my_sites.csv"))

names(worldclim)
names(soilgrids)
```

# merge together
```{r}
site_static <- flux_static |>
  left_join(worldclim, by = "site_id")

# For SoilGrids: pick topsoil (0-30 cm) and one property, e.g., clay content
# Or create a summary table per site for the report
soil_topsoil <- soilgrids |>
  filter(bottom_cm <= 30) |>
  group_by(site_id, property) |>
  summarise(
    topsoil_mean = weighted.mean(mean, (bottom_cm - top_cm), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = property, values_from = topsoil_mean)

# Merge soil data
site_static <- site_static |>
  left_join(soil_topsoil, by = "site_id")

print(site_static)
```



# Introduction

# Data Sources

- **ERA5‑Land** – daily climate variables.
- **WorldClim** – bioclimatic indices.
- **SoilGrids** – soil property layers.
- **PlantTraits** – functional trait measurements.
- **iNaturalist** – biodiversity observations.
- **MODIS** – NDVI/EVI composites.
